settings.setup_title: What you need from the provider
settings.setup_sub: One-time set-up with PayTabs or HyperPay.
settings.https_warn: This site is not opened over HTTPS. Payment providers only call and redirect to HTTPS addresses — set APP_URL to your https:// address before going live.

paytabs_steps.s1: Open a PayTabs merchant account for the clinic's country (paytabs.com). They ask for the commercial registration or clinic licence, the owner's ID and a bank account in the clinic's name.
paytabs_steps.s2: In the PayTabs dashboard open Developers → Key management and create a server key of type API. Enter the Profile ID and the server key here.
paytabs_steps.s3: Choose the region the account was opened in (a Jordanian account: Jordan).
paytabs_steps.s4: PayTabs sends every result to the callback address below and brings the patient back to the return address. Both must be reachable over HTTPS; the last part is added for each payment.
paytabs_steps.s5: Start with a test profile (test cards only), press "Test connection" and try one booking. Then enter the live profile and choose Live.

hyperpay_steps.s1: Ask HyperPay (hyperpay.com) for a COPYandPAY merchant account. They need the commercial registration or clinic licence, the owner's ID, the bank account and the website address.
hyperpay_steps.s2: HyperPay gives an access token and an entity ID for Visa/Mastercard, and a separate entity ID for mada. Enter them here.
hyperpay_steps.s3: Give HyperPay the website address below so their card widget is allowed on it. The site must use HTTPS.
hyperpay_steps.s4: After paying, the patient comes back to the shopper result address below; DocBook then confirms the payment directly with HyperPay's server.
hyperpay_steps.s5: Use Test with HyperPay's test entities and test cards first. Choose Live when HyperPay activates the live entities.
